meta.title: Two bids: award all 10 units to the L1 vendor (B); approver rejects
gaps: The prepared state contains only one vendor and one bid, so the required A-versus-B comparison, L1 selection, and Awarded Vendors count of 1/2 cannot be tested.
Typing and asserting an allocation of exactly 10 units to Vendor B at 90 each, including the 900 total, is not exposed by the available awarding steps.

Signing in as the approver, rejecting the proposal with a remark, verifying that no PO is created, and confirming the buyer can restart awarding requires another user session and is not expressible by catalog steps.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared state contains only one vendor and one bid, so the required A-versus-B comparison, L1 selection, and Awarded Vendors count of 1/2 cannot be tested.; Typing and asserting an allocation of exactly 10 units to Vendor B at 90 each, including the 900 total, is not exposed by the available awarding steps.; Signing in as the approver, rejecting the proposal with a remark, verifying that no PO is created, and confirming the buyer can restart awarding requires another user session and is not expressible by catalog steps.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS; the prepared-state rules require this as the first step.
Open the awarding page from Master QCS.
Allocate the available prepared bid to the named Vendor B where the prepared fixture exposes that vendor; the step records the allocation counters but cannot set the requested quantity.
Assert the allocation completed for the one line and one available vendor in the prepared state; this is not the requested 1/2 two-vendor assertion.
Create the award proposal from the awarding screen.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify that the proposal is awaiting approval before the unavailable approver action.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal, reject it with a remark, verify that no purchase order is created, and return to Master QCS to confirm awarding can be started again

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to the approver account, reject proposals, verify absence of a PO after rejection, or confirm the buyer's post-rejection restart state.
